*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
** At least eight are killed in clashes in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], [[Libya]]. [http://www.news24.com/Africa/News/at-least-8-killed-in-libya-clashes-20161201 (News 24)], [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2016/Dec-02/383786-militias-clash-in-libyas-tripoli-worst-violence-in-2-years.ashx (''The Daily Star'')]
*[[Military intervention against ISIL]]
**[[Denmark]]'s government announces it will be withdrawing its seven [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]] fighter jets from military operations against [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] in [[Iraq]] and [[Syria]] from mid-December. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-denmark-idUSKBN13R0WA (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*Ministers of the [[European Union]] have given the EU president a mandate to lower charges that [[mobile phone]] services can impose on one another for keeping each others' customers connected as the customers "roam," that is, travel about Europe. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-telecoms-roaming-idUSKBN13R1WB?il=0 (Reuters)] 
*[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Barack Obama]] blocks [[China]]'s Fujian Grand Chip Investment Fund's acquisition of the U.S. [[Semiconductor industry|semiconductor]] business of [[Germany|German-based]] [[Aixtron]] because of national security concerns. The [[Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy|German Economy Ministry]] withdrew its approval in October. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-cenbank-cyberattack-idUSKBN13R1TO (Reuters)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-12-02/obama-blocks-chinese-takeover-of-aixtron-as-u-s-security-risk (Bloomberg)]

;Disasters and accidents 	
*At least 18 people die and two more are injured in a bus accident in [[Hubei]], [[China]]. [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2016-12/02/c_135876961.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]
*[[2016 Southeastern United States wildfires]]
**The death toll from the wildfire that hit the U.S. town of [[Gatlinburg, Tennessee]], rises to 13. [http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_SOUTHERN_WILDFIRES_TNOL-?SITE=AP&SECTION=HOME&TEMPLATE=DEFAULT (AP)]
*The bodies of 21 coal miners are retrieved from an unlicensed coal mine in the [[China|Chinese]] city of [[Qitaihe]] in the province of [[Heilongjiang]]. Four people have been arrested including the owner of the mine and three managers. [http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3996142/21-Chinese-miners-trapped-4-days-confirmed-dead.html (AP via ''Daily Mail'')]
*[[2016 Oakland warehouse fire]]
**At least nine people are killed and 40 are missing in a [[2016 Oakland warehouse fire|warehouse fire]] in [[Oakland, California|Oakland]], [[California]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-38195612 (BBC)], [http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-12-03-US--Warehouse%20Party%20Fire-The%20Latest/id-814e62dd893f485399b20784569ea8b5 (AP)]

;International relations
*[[Taiwan–United States relations]]
**[[United States]] [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] holds a telephone conversation with [[President of the Republic of China|Taiwanese President]] [[Tsai Ing-wen]], the first known contact between a U.S. president or president-elect with a Taiwanese leader since the United States [[One-China policy|recognized]] the [[People's Republic of China]] in 1979. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/trump-spoke-with-taiwanese-president-a-major-break-with-decades-of-us-policy-on-china/2016/12/02/b98d3a22-b8ca-11e6-959c-172c82123976_story.html?wpisrc=al_alert-COMBO-world%252Bnation (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/02/us/politics/trump-speaks-with-taiwans-leader-a-possible-affront-to-china.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')] [http://www.cnn.com/2016/12/02/politics/donald-trump-taiwan/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Foreign Minister of the People's Republic of China|Chinese Foreign Minister]] [[Wang Yi (politician)|Wang Yi]] blames Taiwan for making the call. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-taiwan-idUSKBN13R2NT (Reuters)]
*[[Mercosur]] suspends [[Venezuela]] from the [[South America]]n trading bloc for failing to meet membership requirements on trade and human rights. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-38181198 (BBC)]
 
;Law and crime
*A shooting in Palilula, [[Dolj County]], [[Romania]], leaves at least three people dead, including the gunman, with two more injured. [http://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/evenimente/impuscaturi-la-palilula-o-persoana-a-murit-624439 (Digi 24)] [https://www.realitatea.net/impu-caturi-in-plina-strada-in-dolj-o-persoana-a-murit-iar-alte-doua-sunt-grav-ranite_2009089.html (Realitatea.net)]
*The [[Central Bank of Russia|Russian Central Bank]] says hackers, who were attempting to steal about 5 billion rubles, did take more than 2 billion ($31 million) this year from member bank accounts. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-cenbank-cyberattack-idUSKBN13R1TO (Reuters)] [http://money.cnn.com/2016/12/02/technology/russia-central-bank-hack/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*Approximately 200,000 [[Muslim]]s protest in the [[Indonesia]]n capital [[Jakarta]] against the [[List of Governors of Jakarta|Governor]] [[Basuki Tjahaja Purnama]] for alleged [[blasphemy]]. This is the second mass protest in a month against the minority [[Christianity|Christian]] governor. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/thousands-join-blasphemy-protest-in-indonesian-capital/2016/12/01/894e8d1a-b82b-11e6-939c-91749443c5e5_story.html (AP via ''Washington Post'')]
*Indonesian president [[Joko Widodo]] attends the main event of the rally, [[Jumu'ah|Friday mass prayer]], easing the tension of protesters. [http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2016/12/02/mass-prayer-becomes-cooler-with-jokowis-presence-mpr.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
*[[Gambian presidential election, 2016]]
**Opposition candidate [[Adama Barrow]] defeats [[The Gambia|Gambia]]n [[President of the Gambia|President]] [[Yahya Jammeh]], bringing an end to Jammeh's 22-year-rule in the [[West Africa]]n nation. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/12/02/gambian-president-yahya-jammeh-concedes-defeat-22-years-rule/ (''The Telegraph'')]

*[[2016 NCAA Division I FBS football season]] ([[American football]]):
** In the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference football season|Pac-12 Conference]], the [[2016 Washington Huskies football team|Washington Huskies]] defeat the [[2016 Colorado Buffaloes football team|Colorado Buffaloes]] 41–10 to win the [[2016 Pac-12 Football Championship Game|Pac-12 Football Championship Game]]. It is the first [[Pac-12 Conference|Pac-12]] football title for the Huskies since the conference [[2010–2014 NCAA conference realignment#Pac-10|expanded to 12 schools in 2011]]. [http://www.seattletimes.com/sports/uw-husky-football/no-4-uw-vs-no-9-colorado-live-updates-as-the-huskies-battle-the-buffs-in-the-pac-12-championship/ (''Seattle Times'')]
** In the [[2016 Mid-American Conference football season|Mid-American Conference]], the [[2016 Western Michigan Broncos football team|Western Michigan Broncos]] defeat the [[2016 Ohio Bobcats football team|Ohio Bobcats]] 29–23, remaining unbeaten entering the [[2016–17 NCAA football bowl games|bowl season]] and claiming the program's first [[Mid-American Conference|MAC]] title since 1988. [http://www.espn.com/college-football/recap?gameId=400926941 (AP via ESPN)]
